thread:
ana: Quick sync on CloudMart partnership. Scope: marketplace listing + joint webinar + benchmark blog. Primary goals: demo-ready integration, clear registration funnel, and tidy SF lead routing.

sam: Agree. Funnel idea: marketplace CTA -> Redwood landing page -> short registration form (minimal fields) -> SF mapping to SF-Enterprise. Keep UTMs simple.

tim (CloudMart): Ops can support a marketplace banner for announcement week. We need a 40-60 word blurb, a one-pager, and logos in SVG + PNG by EOD Friday.

devon: I'll draft announcement copy, blog outline (800-1k words), and social posts. Q: embargo same-day or stagger? Recommend same-day listing + webinar announce.

nina: Pilot preview metrics: ~2.1x throughput in steady state, ~30% avg token cost reduction, p50 latency down ~33% on our standard prompts. I'll upload CSV + chart PNG by Thu noon.

lauren-sales: For routing: use lead_source=cloudmart_marketplace and route to SF campaign "CloudMart Integration"; attendees -> SDR outreach within 48 hrs; registrants who no-show -> 1-week nurture with recording.

sam: Proposed UTM template: 
```
utm_source=cloudmart&utm_medium=partner_marketplace&utm_campaign=cm_integration_may2026
```
Also include hidden form field partner_id=cloudmart.

tim (CloudMart): We can include UTMs on the CTA and prefill a partner param in our modal. Please confirm param name.

devon: Announcement cadence: I'd push marketplace live AM, blog + social + webinar registration PM same day to concentrate SEO/traffic. Thoughts?

ana: Prefer joint day. CloudMart needs >=14 days lead time for banner, so webinar must be >=2 weeks after announce.

sam: Draft timeline:
- Fri: asset drafts due
- Tue: dry-run + slide freeze
- Announcement Thu (marketplace live AM; joint blog + social PM)
- Webinar: 14 days after announcement

lauren-sales: I'll build SF campaign and task templates; need exact utm and partner_id field names to wire forms.

nina: Will upload final slides and charts 48 hrs before rehearsal. Post-event I'll refresh benchmark slides and push final numbers.

devon: I'll have blog draft + three social variants (X, LinkedIn, CloudMart community) by rehearsal. Also draft PR blurb; need to align on embargo.

sam: Tracking metrics: banner impressions & clicks, landing page CTR, registration -> attendance %, MQL -> SQL within 30 days, demo requests. Make sure we capture banner clicks in attribution.

tim (CloudMart): Ops confirmed banner slot for announcement week. Creative specs incoming. We can also co-send an email to a small segment for boost if you want.

ana: Action items (owners + due dates):
- tim: marketplace blurb + one-pager + logos (EOD Fri)
- nina: benchmark slides + CSV (Thu noon)
- devon: announcement blog draft + social (rehearsal)
- sam: SF mapping, UTM implementation + tracking (Mon)
- lauren-sales: post-webinar workflow + SF tasks (Mon)

calendar-bot: Event created: "CloudMart x Redwood: Integration Webinar" on 2026-05-26 17:00 UTC. Organizer: ana. Join link: https://meet.example.com/cloudmart-redwood

ana: Please confirm by EOD Fri with :thumbsup: or flag blockers. If all green we lock announcement date and start creative.

sam: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:, will flag embargo preference in rehearsal.

tim (CloudMart): :thumbsup:, confirmed from ops.

lauren-sales: Confirmed, building SF flows.

nina: Confirmed, uploading artifacts Thu.

ana: Thanks everyone — closing thread. Assets on shared drive and we'll use rehearsal channel for last-minute changes.
